name: Nuclear Sun
description: A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on June 16th, 2020.
This paint could have been unlocked at Tier 7 of the June 2020 Challenge B.
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.
Just imagine what you could do if you could harness the immense energy of the sun! Until that's possible, though, you'll just have to settle for this cool-looking paint.
